contracts_rationale: Internal refactor: routes existing non-charter callers onto the resolve_pack_chain() authority and widens an architectural gate. No new or changed external/API interfaces.
purpose_context: Follow-up to #6006, which established resolve_pack_chain() as the single ordered org-pack-chain authority and migrated the charter surfaces onto it behind a path-scoped empty-allowlist gate. This mission completes that unification across the ~12 remaining non-charter callers, widens the FR-006 census tree-wide with the allowlist kept empty, and completes #4984 fail-closed behaviour on the governed non-charter decision surfaces.
purpose_tldr: Route every remaining org-pack chain-deriving caller through the single resolve_pack_chain() authority and widen the empty-allowlist gate tree-wide.
